item.title: The Conversation: The Global Race to Make a Practical Quantum Computer Just Took a Big Leap Forward
item.summary: Guest Post by Animesh Datta, Professor of Quantum Information Science, University of Warwick, for The Conversation In the global race to build bigger and better quantum computers, researchers have taken a step forward. A new machine called Helios is a radically different system compared to other quantum computers. Quantum computers harness the power of quantum mechanics, […]
